Stock market news | India Infrastructure Finance Company Ltd: Govt to Sell Stake in IIFCL IPO

The government plans to partially divest its shareholding in India Infrastructure Finance Company Ltd through an initial public offering. Alongside the government stake sale, IIFCL will issue fresh shares to raise capital.
